operating-systems-concepts--system-call.note: Only the trap switches mode and stack; the wrapper hides that crossing so the call looks like an ordinary function.

operating-systems-concepts--file-managem.title: open, read, write, close
lines: ssize_t n = read(fd, buf, sizeof buf);
operating-systems-concepts--file-managem.note: open returns a per-process descriptor, and read and write advance the shared file offset.

operating-systems-concepts--process-cont.title: fields of a process control block
operating-systems-concepts--process-cont.note: The PCB is both the identity record and the save area, so a context switch mostly reads and writes these fields.

operating-systems-concepts--context-swit.title: saving one context and loading another
lines: switch_mm(prev, next)      # reload the page-table base
operating-systems-concepts--context-swit.note: Registers and bookkeeping move first; the address space changes only when the page-table base is reloaded.

operating-systems-concepts--round-robin.title: round robin with q = 3 ms
operating-systems-concepts--round-robin.note: Bursts are 8, 5 and 2 ms, all arriving at t = 0; mean turnaround is 12 ms and mean waiting time 7 ms.

operating-systems-concepts--deadlock-avo.title: banker safety check with available (3, 3, 2)
operating-systems-concepts--deadlock-avo.note: Need = Max - Alloc; P1 is the first row that fits the available vector, so the safe sequence starts P1.

operating-systems-concepts--page-table.title: one 32-bit page table entry
rows: 1 = read or written since last clear
physical page frame holding the page
operating-systems-concepts--page-table.note: The MMU tests the present bit first; a zero traps to the kernel, which fills in the frame number.

steps.label: DMA done, page now in frame 12

operating-systems-concepts--page-fault.note: The program never sees the fault because the instruction re-executes once the mapping is valid.

operating-systems-concepts--optimal-page.title: optimal replacement, three frames
operating-systems-concepts--optimal-page.note: OPT evicts the page used farthest in the future; on this string it needs 6 faults, the minimum possible.

operating-systems-concepts--wait-operati.title: wait and signal on a counting semaphore
operating-systems-concepts--wait-operati.note: On contention the value goes negative, and its magnitude counts the processes blocked on S.

grant the bus and write the word

operating-systems-concepts--direct-memor.note: The CPU is free between steps 1 and 4 instead of copying every word itself.

operating-systems-concepts--access-contr.title: subjects against objects
operating-systems-concepts--access-contr.note: A column is an access control list, a row is a capability list, and the matrix is the model both project.
